hypothesis: The verified one-field planner contract is sufficient if execution is a compact ranking of every safe legal action by contribution to grow, secure, or finish. Removing the legacy branch cascade should prevent symbolic and transport loops while retaining strategic options that the narrow v33 taxonomy lost.
single_change: Replace chooseCaptainUnderpantsRuntimeAction beneath intent-core with one utility ranking. Each legal action receives progress, safety, closure, and friction features; the current intent supplies the weights. Exact actions and targets remain executor-owned.

executor_contract.shape: one utility function plus deterministic tie-break
hard_invariants: select only an exact server-offered legal action ID
never harm K1Z Mickey Mouse, including disguised weapon builds
current incoming attacks raise defensive utility
hold ranks last whenever a productive safe action exists
executor_contract.anti_loop: repetition contributes friction independent of intent

replay_acceptance: first v34 hosted loss no longer spends 15 decisions repeating target_player under grow
sole v34 hosted win retains a finish-dominant attack path
all three intents change ranking on representative full menus
symbolic actions remain available but cannot dominate a productive action through repetition
local_acceptance: full-suite delta is zero outside known historical failures
exact-image local 16-player run has planner markers and zero rejection or degradation
no target_player, alliance, boat, or hold loop exceeds its generic repetition bound
hosted_stop_conditions: planner reasons absent from any replay
any unexplained fallback, degradation, rejection, or parse failure
any repeated symbolic-action loop while a productive safe action exists
